name: Sugar Free D'Lite Chocochips Cookies
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sweeteners (Maltitol, Sucralose), Choco Chips (18%) {Chocochips [Sweetener (INS 965), Edible Vegetable Fat (Hydrogenated), Cocoa Powder, Emulsifiers (INS 492, Soya Lecithin), Nature Identical (Vanillin) Flavouring Substance], Chocolate Chips [Sweetener (INS 965), Cocoa Powder, Cocoa Butter, Emulsifier (Soya Lecithin), Nature Identical (Vanilla) Flavouring Substance]}, Hydrogenated Oil (Palm and Palm Kernel), Oats (5%), Butter, Quinoa (2%), Cocoa Powder, Milk Solids, Iodised Salt, Raising Agents (INS 500(ii), INS 503(ii)), Nature Identical (Chocolate) and Artificial (Vanilla) Flavouring Substances, Emulsifiers (Soya lecithin, INS 472). ALLERGENS: Contains Milk, Gluten (Oats, Wheat), Soy. May contains traces of nuts.
